acceptance.output_evidence: Banner fill rgb(201,197,197); darkest text pixel rgb(123,51,6) (= amber-900, the DARK idiom). Contrast text-vs-banner-fill 5.30:1; text-vs-raw-silver-canvas rgb(195,202,218) 5.51:1 -- both above the WCAG AA 4.5:1 floor for normal text. Dark-on-light throughout; no text-white*, no text-{color}-100..300, no bg-white/N on the canvas. Zoomed crop READ and legible. Session log committed with a Compiler Tools section (path in session_log field).
acceptance.denominator: N/A -- contrast is a computed ratio per colour pair, not a count; both pairs (text-vs-fill, text-vs-canvas) are reported rather than the more favourable one alone.

mutant.description: Revert the four product files to pristine (git checkout --) and re-run the IDENTICAL degraded exercise (same --fail, same fixture, same port). If the verification is real, the banner must vanish and generated_at must revert to a synthesised now-stamp. If it does not, C1/C2 were measuring something other than my change.
mutant.expected: No fallback banner in the render; dataLoader reports a synthesised current timestamp instead of 2026-04-15; no DEGRADED warn in the console.
mutant.observed: FIRED. BEFORE-degraded.png read: page header goes straight to TRENDING TOPICS, no banner anywhere (page height 2462 px vs 2532 px after -- the 70 px delta IS the banner's own footprint). Console: no '[market.getAllReturns] DEGRADED' line at all, and '[dataLoader] ... updated 2026-08-11T22:29:30.128Z'. All three expected reversions observed.

determinism.method: Rendered the same route against the same code and the same fixture twice (AFTER-healthy-primary.png, AFTER-healthy-run2.png) and pixel-diffed, to establish the run-to-run noise floor before attributing any BEFORE/AFTER delta to the change.
determinism.observed: 106 changed px of 3,545,280, confined to bbox (1253,1059,1269,1069) -- the CNN Fear&Greed wall-clock minute digit, which advances between runs. Everything else is byte-stable. The instrument is stable apart from one known wall-clock element, and that element is identified rather than waved off.

surprises: portal/src/pages/ModelPortfolios.tsx:873 fails `bun run lint` with react-hooks/preserve-manual-memoization ('Could not preserve existing memoization'). PRE-EXISTING and not in my diff -- `bun run lint` runs `eslint .` so it fails repo-wide regardless of the paths passed, which means any seat running the repo lint gate right now sees a red that is not theirs. No action taken.

getTickerReturns (market.ts:~283) synthesises `generated_at: marketData.generated_at || new Date().toISOString()` -- the same self-reporting-as-current defect as B, in the single-ticker accessor feeding IndexPerformanceModal. Outside this TO's scope. No action taken.

The /market local render 401s on BOTH accessor legs without backend credentials, landing on the terminal-failure path. That means the ui-smoke default run has never been exercising the primary leg for this page -- a fixture is required to render the healthy state at all. Relevant to anyone reading a past /market smoke render as evidence of healthy-path behaviour. No action taken.

The portal submodule has no committer identity configured (`git commit` fails with 'Committer identity unknown'); I supplied one per-invocation with `git -c` rather than writing global config. Every portal-committing seat hits this. No action taken.
